none: PAS NLM-D1BEE1: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), probably Emperor right issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust cuirassed and diademed right. Reverse description: probably emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this worn coin. Diameter: 16.2mm, Weight: 1.33gms, die axis: 6
